objections.objection: The registry records SSGA terms_excerpt as empty and the rationale says no terms text is obtainable, while the operative license sentence is embedded in the footers of the very workbooks the lane downloaded and staged. The FD0 record is therefore incomplete as evidence narrative: terms text was available in-session and is ADVERSE (no reproduction/copying/transmission without express written consent). This does not change the verdict - it makes the block stronger - but FD0's stated rationale is partially inaccurate and the staged copies' own license basis needs owner-level judgment.

rationale: FD0 cannot PASS without either (a) an owner-authorized real-browser terms capture for SSGA - which would still hit the adverse embedded no-reproduction clause - or (b) owner authorization of account creation at an account-gated provider (excluded by the frozen zero-cost boundary), or (c) a source that does not exist today offering boundary-compliant, license-proven, deterministic daily ETF OHLCV. No REFUTE_BLOCKED path exists within the boundary. Per PLAN 9 the cycle must close STOCKS_FREE_V1_BLOCKED_FREE_DATA_AUTHORITY; gates must not be weakened and proposals must not start.
